resume: Melodee is a multi-engine synth with sequencer: four synth tracks (PROPHET, FM6, CZ-1, SID, DRUM or a MIDI track) and up to four more MIDI tracks, 64-step patterns, songs, 70 scales and automatic chords. Each button opens its family of pages; held, it opens a layer or an action.

commandes.role: On Stage, lowers the octave (OCT- and OCT+ together: back to zero). Everywhere else, goes back or cancels. With EDIT held: undoes further. In step editing, moves the cursor.

On Stage, raises the octave. Everywhere else, enters, confirms or opens. Held on a page that has one, opens its action sheet (Init sound, Copy to..., Add track, Remove track...). With EDIT held: redoes.

The track's effects rack (NOTE TAIL, NOTE ECHO, then the Shared row with its three shared slots). Held: the 27 SLOOP effects on the master, one per key, as long as it is held; double press: the layer stays open.

Printed SEL, called SCL by Melodee: SCALES (family, scale, ROOT, QNT), then the SCL settings (ROOT, favorite, QNT, TRN), then CHORD. Held: quick layer, ROOT on the keys, scale and chord on the knobs; double press to lock it.
ENV pages (ATK, DEC, SUS, REL) then ENV DEST (filter, pitch, shape). In note editing, held: fine lengths and SLIDE.
LFO pages (RATE, WAVE, PHS, FADE), LFO 2, LFO DEST then MOD (four routes). Held while turning a knob: temporary setting, restored on release (OCT+ keeps it).

The track's engine pages. Held: undo (the last sound or pattern load, a take, a capture; up to eight levels). On NOTES, one press deletes the highlighted note; while recording, held erases as the playhead passes.

MIXER (LEVEL, PAN, MUTE), then GLOBAL (A4, BUDGET, CLK, TUNE), then SYSTEM (MIDI input, DRUM channel, ROUT). Held: mute and solo layer on the keys, TAP tempo, track levels on the knobs; GLO + PLAY restarts from the beginning without stopping.
Returns to Stage, the play screen; on Stage, another press opens the chord view (circle of fifths). Held: the settings menu (colors, HOLD, LIGHTS, AUTOSAVE, HOME SELECT...).
PRESETS, USER or PROJECT. Held (or SAVE + REC): rewrites the project in its slot, playback stops first.
ARP pages (MODE, Rate, Octave, Gate) then ARP 2 (SWG, PROB, HOLD, ORD).

The sequencer family: NOTES (piano roll, grid on a DRUM track), PATTERN, TEMPO, PATTERNS, SONG, MOTION. Held: the PATTERNS grid; the first eight white keys pick the pattern, the first eight black keys the track.
Starts and stops all tracks. REC + PLAY arms and starts in one gesture.

Arms or disarms the selected track without starting playback; during playback, recording begins at the next pattern start and continues until the next REC. Held: Capture, the last bars played written into the pattern; on SONG, the jam becomes the arrangement.
Master volume.
Turns through the pages of the open section, in both directions. On Stage, sets what HOME SELECT points to (BPM by default). GLO + SELECT: GLO SELECT setting on all pages.
Browses the track's sounds (KNOB 1 the list: category, FAV, RECENT; KNOB 2 the sound). On engine pages, jumps between sections; on NOTES, zooms.
Picks the track, from 1 up to the last one used, on all pages; the screen takes its color.
Play the selected track, in the scale according to QNT (OFF chromatic, SNAP, WHITE, ALL, MPC). In layers and grids, they also select patterns, effects, roots and drum lanes.
QNT WHITE: the scale on the white keys only, C4 plays ROOT. On the DRUM grid: the steps. SEQ held: patterns 1 to 8.
QNT WHITE: muted. On the DRUM grid: the lanes. SEQ held: tracks 1 to 8.

gestes: GLO or SEL held: its quick layer; double press within 300 ms to lock it, one press to close it.
EDIT held then OCT- or OCT+: undo further or redo.
SEQ held, a pattern key held for one second: OCT- to exit, the same key to clear the pattern, another to copy it; C# halves its length, D# doubles it.
OCT+ held while turning SELECT, KNOB 1 or KNOB 2: select a range (notes, sounds of the USER bank).

modes.texte: The HOME screen: one line per track (sound, pattern, steps played), the notes played in front of the waveform. The four knobs set the track's sound according to the engine: PROPHET CUTOFF, RES, filter envelope, release; FM6 MLVL, MRAT, MEG, DTUN; CZ-1 WAVE, DCW, DETUNE, VIBRATO; SID WAVE, PW, CUT, RES; DRUM TUNE, TONE, DECY, SNAP.

SEQ. KNOB 1 STEP moves through the steps, KNOB 2 PITCH changes or inserts a note, KNOB 3 LENGTH the length, KNOB 4 VEL the velocity. EDIT deletes the highlighted note, OCT+ opens its sheet (Move, Copy, Delete...).

REC arms the track. When stopped and armed, the first note starts playback and records from step zero. The playing is kept as is (timing, velocity, duration); SEQ > TEMPO > QNT quantizes the take afterwards if you wish. EDIT held undoes the take.

a_savoir: AUTOSAVE: when stopped and with no action for five seconds, a project that has a slot saves itself to it. HOME held > AUTOSAVE to turn it off.
MIDI: USB and TRS inputs; GLO > SYSTEM > ROUT picks the four channels that play tracks 1 to 4, or SEL to send everything to the selected track. The keys send on the track's channel.
